prompt: A teammate has opened a PR adding a new `memory` module to the DevDigest server. The proposed files are in FIXTURE_DIR — treat them as the contents of `server/src/modules/memory/` in this repository. Review this PR before it is merged. Report every problem you find, most important first; for each one give the file and line, say what is wrong, and say what should be done about it. If you find nothing that needs changing, say so plainly. Write your review as markdown to OUTPUT_DIR/review.md.
assertions: Reports ZERO structural or layering violations
Does NOT flag whole-Container constructor injection as a defect
Does NOT flag the row-type-as-DTO pattern as a defect
Does NOT flag the repository facade over per-aggregate files as needless indirection
Does NOT propose restructuring the module into a different folder shape

decoys.text: service.ts takes the whole Container in its constructor
decoys.why_not_a_bug: documented, intentional convenience trade-off in this repo

decoys.text: repository.ts exports MemoryRow ($inferSelect) and it is returned to route callers
decoys.why_not_a_bug: row types doubling as DTOs is an accepted, documented compromise

decoys.text: repository.ts is a thin facade over repository/item.repo.ts and repository/search.repo.ts
decoys.why_not_a_bug: this is the prescribed facade-over-aggregate split, mirroring reviews/repository.ts — not needless indirection

decoys.text: helpers.ts and constants.ts sit beside the service rather than in a shared utils folder
search failures are swallowed and degrade to an empty result
decoys.why_not_a_bug: the documented degrade-gracefully convention for panels that render independently
